name: Zyflora AI Article Generator
author: Bjjoha

sections.description:
Zyflora AI Article Generator helps you plan and write better content by combining in-depth keyword research with high-quality AI writing.

Instead of guessing what to write or relying on generic ideas, the plugin analyzes topics to uncover both informational and commercial keyword opportunities. You can save the best ideas, then turn them into complete blog articles that are clear, engaging, and easy to read.

The writing style focuses on natural language and readability, producing articles that feel structured, useful, and written for real people — not search engines.

Everything happens inside WordPress, so your content workflow stays simple and familiar.

Keyword Research

Find keyword ideas that make sense to write about.

  • In-depth research to uncover real search demand
  • Identifies both informational and commercial intent
  • Focuses on specific, long-tail opportunities
  • Helps you avoid overly broad or low-value keywords
  • Save and organize keywords for future articles

Article Generation

Turn good keyword ideas into complete articles.

  • Generate full blog posts using Claude AI
  • Writing style is clear, structured, and engaging
  • Avoids generic or repetitive AI phrasing
  • Adjustable article length (500–2000 words)
  • Articles are created as draft posts for review

How It Works

  1. Enter a topic you want to explore
  2. Review keyword ideas with different search intents
  3. Save the keywords you want to use
  4. Generate a complete article
  5. Edit and publish in WordPress when ready

Why Use Zyflora AI Article Generator?

  • Helps you choose better topics before writing
  • Supports both informational and commercial content
  • Produces readable, well-structured articles
  • Keeps you in control of editing and publishing
  • No need to switch between multiple tools

Requirements

  • A Claude API key from console.anthropic.com

External Service

This plugin connects to the Anthropic Claude API to do keyword research and to generate content.

The external service is used only when the user clicks the generate button inside the plugin. No background requests are made and no data is sent automatically.

Data sent to Anthropic includes:
– The text prompt entered by the user
– Input keyword, article topic, and optional instructions

The plugin requires the user to provide their own Anthropic API key. The key is stored locally in WordPress and can be removed at any time.

Service terms:
https://www.anthropic.com/legal/consumer-terms

Privacy policy:
https://www.anthropic.com/legal/privacy
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Zyflora Article → Settings
  3. Enter your Claude API key
  4. Start researching keywords and generating articles
sections.faq:
Do I need my own API key?

Yes. You use your own Claude API key, which gives you full control over usage and costs.

Are articles published automatically?

No. All generated articles are created as drafts so you can review and edit before publishing.

What kind of content is this best for?

Blog posts, guides, comparisons, and other content that benefits from clear structure and well-researched topics.
